safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold supports abdominal pain but does not specify LQ location; transcript only indicates 'a little bit of abdominal pain' without localization.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: The note incorrectly localizes the abdominal pain to the left lower quadrant when the patient only reported mild, nonspecific abdominal pain. While this can mislead a clinician toward particular etiologies (e.g., colitis/diverticulitis) and affect subsequent workup, in this context of uncomplicated diarrhea without red flags it is unlikely to directly cause significant harm.
